summary: Audit the RN app against prototype/pawductivity_v1.html area by area, listing concrete 1:1 discrepancies to fix
logs: Audit complete: 81 divergences (12 high, 39 medium, 30 low).

high.title: Full-screen overlays have NO exit (slide-down) animation; they vanish instantly
high.proto_evidence: closeSlide() (line 3418-3428) removes 'slide-up' and adds 'slide-down', waiting 250ms before removing 'active'. CSS line 59 `.slide-down{animation:slidedown .26s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.9,.5) both;}` + line 62 `@keyframes slidedown{from{transform:none}to{transform:translateY(100%)}}`. Every close path uses it (e.g. line 1973 closeSlide('focus'), 2370 closeShop, 3138 closePremium, 3147 closeScreen).
high.current: closeOverlay() immediately does `overlays.slice(0,-1)`; OverlayHost then renders the next overlay or returns null on the same frame. The Animated container only ever animates the OPEN (translateY H->0); there is no exit animation, so a closing overlay disappears with a hard cut.
high.expected: The closing overlay should slide DOWN off-screen (translateY 0 -> full height) over 260ms with easing cubic-bezier(.4,0,.9,.5) before it is unmounted.
high.fix: Keep rendering the closing overlay while animating: on close, run Animated.timing(translateY, {toValue: H, duration: 260, easing: Easing.bezier(0.4,0,0.9,0.5), useNativeDriver:true}) and only pop the stack in its completion callback. Requires a 'closing' state (e.g. a store flag or a local ref holding the outgoing overlay) so OverlayHost can animate it out.

high.title: Reward popup uses a bottom slide-up instead of scrim-fade + card pop-scale + trophy spin
high.proto_evidence: line 488 `#reward.show{display:flex;animation:fade .25s both;}` (backdrop fades in); line 489 `.rewardcard{...animation:pop .45s cubic-bezier(.2,1.3,.4,1) both;}` with line 189 `@keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(.4);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}` (card pops with overshoot); line 490 `.rewardcard .burst{...animation:spin 1.2s ease;}` + line 493 `@keyframes spin{from{transform:rotate(-20deg) scale(.5)}to{transform:none}}` (trophy spins in). Close: line 2006 adds 'fade-out' (fadeout .2s).
high.current: reward is in the FULL slide-up map, so the whole overlay INCLUDING its dark scrim slides up from the bottom via Animated.spring (during which the top of the screen is uncovered). RewardOverlay is a static View: the card does not pop-scale and the trophy burst does not spin.
high.expected: Backdrop fades in (opacity 0->0.55 over ~250ms), the card scales in from 0.4->1 with overshoot over 450ms cubic-bezier(.2,1.3,.4,1) + opacity 0->1, and the trophy burst rotates from -20deg/scale .5 to rest over ~1.2s.
high.fix: Remove 'reward' from OverlayHost's FULL slide-up container (mount it directly like SHEET so it is not translated). In RewardOverlay add entrance animations: Animated backdrop opacity, an Animated.spring/timing scale (0.4->1 with overshoot) + opacity on the card, and a rotation Animated.timing on the burst.

medium.title: Focus screen slides up from the bottom, but the proto FADES it in

CSS line 56-57 `.fade-in{animation:fade .28s ease both;}` `@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}`. Note it still CLOSES with slide-down (line 1973 closeSlide('focus')).

medium.expected: Focus should fade in on open: opacity 0->1 with a small translateY 8px->0 over 280ms ease (not a full-screen slide from the bottom). It should still slide DOWN on close.
medium.fix: Give focus a distinct entrance: animate opacity 0->1 and a small translateY (8px->0) over 280ms instead of the full-height slide-up, while keeping the shared slide-down on close.

medium.title: Overlay open uses a bouncy spring instead of the proto's fixed 320ms ease-out curve
medium.proto_evidence: line 58 `.slide-up{animation:slideup .32s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;}` + line 61 `@keyframes slideup{from{transform:translateY(100%)}to{transform:none}}` — a 320ms ease-out with no overshoot.
medium.current: Animated.spring(translateY, {toValue:0, friction:9, tension:65}) — spring physics with a settle/possible overshoot and a timing that does not match the proto's fixed 320ms.
medium.expected: A timing animation of exactly 320ms with easing cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1) and no overshoot.
medium.fix: Replace the spring with Animated.timing(translateY, {toValue:0, duration:320, easing:Easing.bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), useNativeDriver:true}).

medium.title: Bottom sheets (capture/goal/plan) fade the whole modal instead of fading the scrim while the dialog slides
medium.proto_evidence: line 353 `.scrim{...animation:fade .2s both;}` (scrim/backdrop fades); line 356 `.dialog{...animation:slideup .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;}` (the dialog card itself slides up from translateY(100%)). Close: line 354 `.scrim.closing{animation:fadeout .24s both;}` + line 355 `.scrim.closing .dialog{animation:slidedown .26s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.9,.5) both;}` (scrim fades out while dialog slides down).
medium.current: Modal uses animationType="fade", so the scrim AND the dialog fade in/out together; the dialog never translates up from the bottom.
medium.expected: The scrim fades (0.2s) while the dialog card slides up from translateY(100%)->0 over 0.3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); on close the scrim fades out (0.24s) and the dialog slides down over 0.26s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.9,.5).
medium.fix: Set Modal animationType="none" and drive the transition internally: Animated opacity on the scrim View plus an Animated.timing translateY on the dialog for both open and close (mount the sheet, then animate; on close animate before onClose unmounts it).

medium.title: Popping a stacked overlay re-animates the revealed PARENT (it slides up again)
medium.proto_evidence: Each screen is a separate persistent `.screen` element; closeSlide (line 3418-3428) animates ONLY the child out and the parent underneath keeps its 'active' state untouched. Open funcs add slide-up only to the opened id (e.g. line 3177 insights, 3137 premium), never to the parent.
medium.current: The open effect depends on `depth`, and OverlayHost renders only the top overlay. When a child is popped, `depth` changes and the effect re-runs, resetting translateY to H and springing the newly-revealed parent up from the bottom again.
medium.expected: When popping back to a parent overlay, the parent must stay stationary; only the closing child should animate (slide down).
medium.fix: Only run the entrance animation when an overlay is PUSHED (depth increases / a genuinely new top mounts), not when depth decreases. Track the previous depth and skip the slide-up on pop (combine with the exit-animation fix in finding 1 so the outgoing child animates instead).
